notes.title: 1.0.35 - 100% DEATHLESS & QOL & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you all for the positive reviews after the launch![/h2][p]It's always fun to watch people play through and get a hang of the controls for the first time! [/p][p][/p][h3]The main things I wanted to address with this update:[/h3][p]I noticed some people playing multiplayer for the first time didn't get to experience the outro - this was due to the outro being skipped by default when in a multiplayer game. [/p][p]Solution? The outro is [u]unskippable[/u] on first playthrough, just like the skip intro toggle. It wont care whether or not you're in a multiplayer game, it'll either play or not depending on the option.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.speedrun.com/Unaccessible/runs/y2nkv56y"]The any% world record is 9:29.914 which is absolutely mind blowing! Congrats to UULaCrevette[/url][/p][previewyoutube="v1bEdiIyb2U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]He also holds the record for [b]100% [/b]and [b]DEATHLESS [/b]too which is [u]why this update is so important.[/u][/p][p][/p][p][i]..drumroll...[/i]
[/p][h2][b]INTRODUCING DEATHLESS 100%[/b] [/h2][p]A new challenge for only the [b]most insane players[/b]. You asked for it and now you have it! (not sure why)[/p][p]It's [b]really, really, really[/b] hard - but [u]you get an achievement[/u] so idk maybe it's worth it to you.[/p][p]Sections of the map have been modified [i]slightly[/i] to allow for a deathless run where collecting all flamingos and no scoping every pool is possible without a single death. There was previously a few "YOLO Flamingos" that have become a little bit more sensible with time.[/p][h3][b]HAVE FUN[/b][/h3][p]and remember to come join the [b]Discord [/b]if you wanna start running and want some tips on routing![/p][p][/p][p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Geometry changes to allow for 100% Deathless[/p][/*][*][p]Skip Outro toggle added to gameplay settings[/p][/*][*][p]No more freeze bug on moving platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Should no longer be possible to reach below the pool i mean ocean[/p][/*][*][p]2 Manager death planes modified slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Escalations middle death plane removed[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Remember to [u]Join the Community[/u] & click all them links below![/b][/p]

notes.title: 1.0.23 - Multiplayer Update [BETA]
notes.notes:
[b]v1.0.23[/b]
● BETA Multiplayer! Hit F11 when in game (uses IP address connection, not steam yet) Port is [b]10277[/b]
● Moved beach ball out of pool to avoid insta-setting of achievement on first play
● Auto-unstuck toggle in options (shouldn't count as a respawn when you do it out of a stuck position)
● Decreased sensitivity of stuck detection
● Ground / respawn point detection made more lenient + bug fix where back section of wheelchair wasn't being checked, leading to annoying respawns
● Fixed unreliable FPS Camera button
● New Skin
● Skins and cosmetics wont change between runs while the game is open

[i]Note: Multiplayer wont have proper Steam integration for a while, it will remain a BETA feature until then.
[/i]
We were going to keep this a testing-only beta feature but we were enjoying it so much I decided to release it upon the world. [i]It's still quite buggy[/i] but I am continuously working on it.

notes.title: ♿ WE ARE LIVE ♿
notes.notes:
[b]LETSS GOOOOOO.[/b]
It's time for exploring the island, liberating flamingos and no-scoping pools. 

How do I even describe the game? The game is in a lane of it's own, don't even compare it to anything else. Those games are cool but they're not this game. WE LOVE THIS GAME. Because it is not those games. James. Be James, become James and live as James. Hop, roll, dip, dive and.. hop your way to a claim approval. Or not? Tune in to find out!

It's a blast from the past, presented as a unique, hilarious, nostalgic physics platformer. IT'S HARD. But it's not unfair. I believe in respawn points, and so should you. I am tired of having to climb back up from the top.. it was fun for a while but DAMN I am so over it!

On the serious though - if you enjoy the game [u][b]PLEEEEEEEEASE [/b][/u]leave a review. It's the best way to increase visibility!

Come join the discord and live it up with the fellas! Share your trials and tribulations from the island of rejected insurance claims.
